Include mixed test_publication_architecture cases, test_post_merge_signature, TestBetaReleaseSurface, relative/example/external-link checkers, CLI inline public-contract guard, API symbols, public soundness records, platform-manifest generated block facts, README version substitution and linkcheck placeholder policy.
